user.description: Voxprint tells which enrolled person spoke to an Assist satellite. It needs the Voxprint app, which turns each utterance into a voiceprint and keeps nothing. Add speakers after this step.

error.name_taken: Another speaker already has this name.

data_description.name: How the speaker sensors will call this person. Each speaker needs a different name.
data_description.person: Optional. The speaker sensors then also show the person and their user ID, for automations that compare it with who is logged in.

reconfigure.description: Renaming a speaker keeps their voiceprint.

data_description.name: How the speaker sensors will call this person. Each speaker needs a different name.
data_description.person: Optional. The speaker sensors then also show the person and their user ID, for automations that compare it with who is logged in.

user.description: After adding the speaker, turn on their Enrollment switch and have them talk to a satellite, alone, for about 3 minutes.

app_incompatible.title: The Voxprint app runs another model
app_incompatible.description: The Voxprint app answered with the model `{model}`, which this version of the integration can't compare with its voiceprints, so no speaker is named. Update the app and the integration to matching versions.

unsupported_core.title: Voxprint can't hear this version of Home Assistant
unsupported_core.description: The speech-to-text method Voxprint copies audio from is missing in this Home Assistant version, so no speaker is named. Speech-to-text itself keeps working. Update Voxprint, or remove it until an update supports this version.

voiceprints_cleared.title: Voiceprints were cleared
voiceprints_cleared.description: The stored voiceprints were made with the model `{model}`, which can't be compared with the current one, so they were deleted. Turn on each speaker's Enrollment switch and enroll them again.

data_description.satellites: Voxprint listens to these satellites only. Audio from the companion app, the browser or other satellites is never captured.
data_description.threshold: The lowest score that names a speaker, from 0.1 to 0.95. Higher lets fewer strangers through and turns away more utterances of enrolled speakers. Set it from your own satellites' scores: see the documentation on calibration.
